_comment: Biome table for procedural terrain. Selected per column by climate (temperature + moisture, both 0..1, low-frequency noise). First entry whose temp+moisture ranges contain the column's climate wins, so order = priority and the last entry should be a catch-all. surface/subsurface/deep are material names from materials.json. Height does not yet vary per biome (no cliffs); per-biome height + border blending are a planned follow-up.
